page.overview:
Who is Mandel?

Commander Mandel was a Human male operations division Starfleet Security officer who lived and served during the late 24th century.

In 2381, Mandel arrived aboard the to arrest Captain Carol Freeman for the destruction of Pakled Planet. ()

After Freeman was exhonerated, Mandel was alongside the Cerritos senior crew and the team that uncovered the true culprits behind the bombing of Pakled Planet. ()
